description: Default profile: Codex in a Kata Containers microVM, one VM per Herdr pane.
egress_note: Non-empty: enforced default-DROP in the guest (guest/egress.sh) via HERDR_EGRESS_ALLOW + NET_ADMIN. Empty: the guest firewall stays off; without CNI the microVM is loopback-only anyway. See docs/security.md.
image_note: Empty means the plugin default for the agent. Override in config.toml or here with a pinned image, e.g. ghcr.io/nizarfadlan/herdr-kata-codex:0.1.0.

mounts.note: {worktree} is replaced with the focused pane's worktree. Nothing else from the host is mounted.
{agent_config} resolves to config.toml agent_config_dir (read-only). Skipped when unconfigured.

name: herdr-codex-kata
